digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The dashboard shows no new completions today, with eight priorities carrying forward. Outlook confirms one cancellation and a tightly stacked Thursday schedule.

items.label: Consolidate the incident-trigger owner map
items.detail: Owner submissions were due yesterday and the next BCP meeting is Thursday. Combine each trigger, notification owner, and communication path today, then follow up on any missing bucket response.

items.label: Lock the SCV and FirstFire go-live path
items.detail: Today's SCV update set UAT Round I to one week, kept September 18 as the target for UAT sign-off and go-live, and added FirstFire and Hilary to the knowledge-transfer plan. Confirm the remaining production-readiness dates, quota status, funding, sign-offs, and CloudWatch monitoring decisions.

items.label: Date the VAWA Post-21 production launch
items.detail: Admin and acceptance-criteria updates landed yesterday. Confirm the mistreatment-question visibility, final UAT approval, and any intake-process impact, then publish the deployment date.

items.label: Close the Re-Open Cases SOP and handoff path
items.detail: This has remained open since August 13 and has a decision-alignment meeting Thursday. Confirm Leo's feedback date and settle the contractual, financial, and handoff questions before that meeting.

items.label: Set the Security Technology Launch path
items.detail: Confirm the Workplace Services and IT scoping group, sponsor path, first milestone, and Salt Lake City deployment sequence needed before the end of September.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: This has remained open since August 10. Finish the outstanding inputs in the morning focus window or name the dependency preventing closure.

items.label: Resolve the noon Legal walkthrough conflict
items.detail: Decide whether to attend Repository and Intake Form Walkthrough Session 3 or protect the existing blocked time, and arrange coverage for the path not taken.

items.label: Complete LeadUp Module 3A
items.detail: Rippling lists Leading with a Growth Mindset as due Friday, August 21. Use a protected block today or tomorrow so it does not become another overdue training item.

items.label: CoE Biweekly Touchpoint was canceled
items.detail: Jean canceled today's touchpoint because of a double booking and no major discussion topics, returning the 30-minute block.

items.label: 10:00 AM-noon - Amazon Connect, Armando, and a three-way noon conflict
items.detail: Amazon Connect training starts at 10:00 AM, followed by Armando at 11:00 AM. At noon, the Legal Guidance rollout and Amazon Connect project sync overlap the blocked-space hold; settle coverage before the morning begins.

items.label: 1:30-5:00 PM - Re-Open Cases conflicts with BCP before the afternoon project stack
items.detail: Re-Open Cases decision alignment and the BCP/Incident Response meeting both start at 1:30 PM. SMS Automation follows at 2:00 PM, RFE MHE at 3:00 PM, and the weekly team meeting at 4:00 PM; decide the 1:30 priority and send context to the other meeting in advance.
